# Abacus AI Releases Free, Open-Source Abacus AI Bot for Developers

September 21, 2026 10:40 ET\| Source:
[Abacus AI](https://www.globenewswire.com/en/search/organization/Abacus%2520AI)FollowAbacus AI

* * *

Share

- * * *


SAN FRANCISCO, CA, Sept. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --

![](https://ml.globenewswire.com/Resource/Download/5ce13d80-829f-4295-b6fc-89c4a5687a15/image1.png)[Expand](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/21/3365631/0/en/abacus-ai-releases-free-open-source-abacus-ai-bot-for-developers.html# "Expand")

[Abacus AI](https://abacus.ai/ "") has released [Abacus AI Bot](https://bot.abacus.ai/ ""), a completely free-to-start, open-source AI agent that brings daily messaging interactions and automated personal workflows into one place. The tool runs on a user's own machine, on Windows, Mac, or Linux, and connects directly into everyday communication tools and productivity platforms without any upfront payment or credit card requirement.

Abacus AI Bot was designed around a simple idea: users shouldn't face paywalls to access capable automation partners. The product lets users chat with Abacus AI directly from the messaging applications they already rely on, build personal bots that work according to their individual style, automate repetitive routines, and hand off complex multi-step tasks — all managed from a client-side desktop application they control.

Most tools limit AI interactions to a single isolated chat window. Abacus AI Bot expands beyond that environment by acting as a versatile personal assistant across an entire workspace. It automates repetitive routines, gathers online research, organizes communication streams, analyzes technical issues, and remembers details across ongoing conversations. The same platform handles structured background automations and day-to-day assistant duties, executing locally on the machine the user already trusts.

The release is completely free to start. Abacus AI Bot requires no financial commitment to begin, and users are not asked for credit card information at any point during onboarding. Every new free Abacus.AI account receives 2,000 complimentary Abacus AI credits. Users can also connect their own external AI models and existing AI subscriptions directly with their own API keys. When free credits run out, users can choose between upgrading their Abacus.AI subscription or continuing with their own connected LLM APIs, providing complete flexibility.

The product is built around persistent memory. Abacus AI Bot remembers conversations, specific instructions, and contextual details over time, allowing it to recall information across sessions rather than starting over every time. Users can create personal bots tailored to their preferences and automate repetitive routines across various tools. Bots can also be configured to run automatically on custom schedules, handling morning summaries, monitoring software bugs, or conducting ongoing research without requiring manual execution.

Because the tool runs client-side, the user's laptop needs to stay powered on and connected to the internet for the bot to continue running tasks in the background. This allows the bot to keep working while the user is away from their desk, offering a practical setup that pairs local control over credentials with continuous background execution.

Connectors and integrations are broad out of the box. Supported services include WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Cloud, Outlook, OneDrive, Jira, Confluence, Dropbox, GitHub, Figma, Notion, Canva, Zoom, DocuSign, Zapier, X (Twitter), Hugging Face, Playwright, Cloudflare Docs, Stripe, and PayPal, with additional connectors planned. For messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord, users link their own accounts to read, send, and receive messages or set up automated replies, and they can disconnect access from their phone at any time. For other services, users authenticate through the service's official OAuth flow and review all requested permissions before approving.

Common workflows can be set up as dedicated bots. Morning Briefs analyze unread emails, upcoming meetings, and Slack messages to prepare an organized briefing before the workday starts. Research Scout searches the internet for fresh news, industry developments, and specific trends relevant to the user. Bug Triage evaluates incoming bug reports and prepares possible resolutions before active troubleshooting begins.

Abacus AI Bot maintains a strict approach to user data and privacy: user data is private, and it is not used to train AI models. Transcripts, crash logs, reports, and related data are sent to Abacus.AI's servers to operate the service. However, user API keys and credentials remain stored locally on the user's computer and never leave the device.

The release is aimed at individual developers, technical professionals, students, and teams who want a versatile, open-source AI agent without mandatory upfront fees. For solo practitioners, it serves as a reliable assistant for automation and research. For organizations and open-source contributors, it delivers an accessible, highly customizable desktop application.

Abacus AI Bot is available immediately on Windows, Mac, and Linux. Users can download the desktop application directly from bot.abacus.ai and sign up with their email address to start using their 2,000 free credits.

**About Abacus AI**

Abacus AI is an artificial intelligence company developing AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, AI model access, development tools, creative technologies, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Its platform brings together conversational AI, research, coding, application development, automation, data analysis, image and video generation, and business workflow capabilities within a unified environment, supporting individuals, developers, and organizations across a wide range of professional and creative tasks.
